info.name: Golblick: 360 photos and videos
info.summary: Panoramas and sphere views for 360 camera files that Nextcloud can't otherwise show
info.description:
Shows Insta360 `.insp` photos as levelled panoramas instead of a generic icon in Files and Memories, with a button to look around each one as a sphere.
The camera stores the two lenses' fisheye images rather than a panorama, so this app builds the panorama in plain PHP using GD, which Nextcloud already requires. Photos need no new server-side dependency and no external programs.
Optionally, it stitches `.insv` videos too, in the background with ffmpeg, into ordinary 360° MP4s that play as a sphere steadied by the camera's motion sensor and can show up in Memories. That's off until you switch it on.
⚠️ Needs `"insp": ["image/jpeg"]` added to `config/mimetypemapping.json`, which has side effects. Read the README before installing. The app's admin settings page can add it for you, and checks the rest of the setup.
info.author: Akshay Rao
